name: Kayena Vacha
text:
कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा
बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतेः स्वभावात् ।
करोमि यद्यत्सकलं परस्मै
नारायणायेति समर्पयामि ॥
meaning: Whatever I do with my body, speech, mind or senses, with my intellect or by my nature, I offer it all to Narayana.
purpose: Offering one’s actions of body, speech and mind.
when: At the close of a practice, or at the end of the day.
